scope: ordinary_manual 177 images, 5719 saved answers; labels unchanged
evaluation: leave one building out; train weights sum to one per image; loss mean within image then within building then across buildings
baseline: intercept plus worker and source categorical effects; unknown training categories map to zero effect
missing_short_span: zero design value only when no short edge, with separate presence indicator; not a measured zero
estimator: weighted ridge linear regression; training-only numerical standardization; alpha=1, intercept unpenalized; no tuning; reduced predictions clipped to [0,1]
time: source-recorded positive seconds, log transformed; old usable and new reported_processed fitted separately; not target-matched operation time
comparisons: all models vs baseline; geometry and three_geometry vs three; geometry vs turn_only and both binary models; three vs both binary models
uncertainty: 5000 paired building bootstrap resamples of saved out-of-fold losses, seed 20261028; conditional descriptive interval, not independent external validation or full-refit bootstrap
checks: source-stratified losses; per-difficulty losses; calibration mean residual; unseen worker counts; per-building support and differences; raw predictions retained
limits: previously explored data; no causal identification; no official relabeling, scoring, fusion, personnel refit, or new collection
